metadata.description: Plugins for people who use Claude Cowork rather than Claude Code, with the reasoning explained beside them.

plugins.name: cowork-kit
plugins.description: CWK Core, the Claude Cowork Kit's routines for any binder: a setup interview that hands back the account instructions and names the binder to install next, plus deciding, interviewing, explaining again, questions for others, a meeting pack, a transcript, confidence, premortem, postmortem, where was I, wrap-up, a new binder, and upgrading a binder made with an earlier release.

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: Your learning binder: learn a subject, a skill or an exam on purpose, with a course plan, short lessons and quizzes, and a record of what has clicked. Part of the Claude Cowork Kit (CWK).

plugins.name: week
plugins.description: Your week binder: triage a pile of obligations into next actions, plan and review the week, write up a meeting, and draft a reply without sending it. Part of the Claude Cowork Kit (CWK).

plugins.name: money
plugins.description: Your money binder: summarize a statement and close each month against your categories, with account details kept out of everything that syncs. Part of the Claude Cowork Kit (CWK).

plugins.name: health
plugins.description: Your health binder: prepare for an appointment, record a visit, keep a weekly log, and turn an article into questions for your clinician; records, never diagnosis. Part of the Claude Cowork Kit (CWK).

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Your research binder: capture ideas anywhere, file them into notes at your desk, write source notes, and answer from what you have read. Part of the Claude Cowork Kit (CWK).
